name: pilot
description: Chrome MV3 side-panel agent that plans one safe, confirmed browser action at a time.

scripts.dev: rimraf dist && concurrently -k -n ui,bg,content "vite build --mode ui --watch" "vite build --mode background --watch" "vite build --mode content --watch"
scripts.build: rimraf dist && vite build --mode ui && vite build --mode background && vite build --mode content
